Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc

Class ConnectionProvider

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc.ConnectionProvider
public final class ConnectionProvider extends Object
Opens, tests and closes JDBC Connections from a ConnectionProfile, independent of any particular database.

Drivers already on the classpath (the bundled SQLite/H2/PostgreSQL/MariaDB) are used directly. A driver that is not on the classpath but has an external jar (a user-added DbDriver) is loaded through a cached URLClassLoader and registered with DriverManager via a shim, so the "add custom driver" path works without relaunching the desktop.

All calls are blocking and must be made off the Swing EDT.
